tool_calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":": "${TOME_LUAJIT:?set TOME_LUAJIT}"; : "${TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT:?set TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT}"; env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua"}
local function order_string(v)
  if v == nil then return "nil" end
  assert(type(v) == "table", "args_order is not a table")
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #v do out[i] = tostring(v[i]) end
  return table.concat(out, ",")
end
local function capture(path)
  local rows, current_section = {}, nil
  _G.section = function(value) current_section = value end
  _G.t = function(source, target, source_tag, args_order)
    rows[#rows + 1] = {source=source, target=target, source_tag=source_tag, args_order=order_string(args_order), section=current_section}
  end
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  chunk()
  return rows
end
local total_target, total_args = 0, 0
for _, file in ipairs(files) do
  local before = capture(".ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/baseline/" .. file)
  local after = capture(file)
  assert(#before == #after, file .. ": record count changed")
  local target_changes, args_changes = 0, 0
  for i = 1, #before do
    assert(before[i].source == after[i].source, file .. ": source changed at record " .. i)
    assert(before[i].source_tag == after[i].source_tag, file .. ": source_tag changed at record " .. i)
    assert(before[i].section == after[i].section, file .. ": section changed at record " .. i)
    if before[i].target ~= after[i].target then target_changes = target_changes + 1 end
    if before[i].args_order ~= after[i].args_order then args_changes = args_changes + 1 end
  end
  total_target = total_target + target_changes
  total_args = total_args + args_changes
  print(string.format("LOAD_OK %s records=%d target_changes=%d args_order_changes=%d", file, #after, target_changes, args_changes))
end
assert(total_target == 22, "expected 22 target changes, got " .. total_target)
assert(total_args == 4, "expected 4 args_order changes, got " .. total_args)
print(string.format("BASELINE_OK target_changes=%d args_order_changes=%d", total_target, total_args))
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output); if (r.exit_code !== 0) text(`EXIT ${r.exit_code}`);
